scientific_integrity: Analytical proof based on independent-variable strong law, maximal Hoeffding bound and martingale functional central limit theorem; finite exact rational checks are supplemental and no claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: The iff condition concerns the universal-for-each-fixed-rule property for independent temporal masks; not all elliptic one-factor randomizations are covered. A common exceptional-free environment for all rules is impossible. General martingale-transform literature may contain an implicit equivalent formulation; independent audit has not occurred.
title: A sharp Cesàro-bias criterion for quenched orthogonality of randomly signed bootstrap walks
